identity.description: LinkedIn Advertising API (Marketing Developer Platform) for managing LinkedIn ad accounts, campaigns, creatives and reporting, documented on Microsoft Learn under linkedin/marketing.
identity.identity_notes: Microsoft Learn LinkedIn Marketing docs and the Developer Portal product catalog describe the Advertising API for Campaign Manager ad accounts. Task assignment hint pointed to the same docs.

auth.oauth_flows: 3-legged OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow via https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/authorization and https://www.linkedin.com/oauth/v2/accessToken; requires Client ID and Client Secret from the Developer Portal Auth tab.
auth.token_refresh: Access tokens have a 60-day lifespan; LinkedIn states it does not generate long-lived access tokens. Programmatic refresh tokens are limited to a small set of partners; otherwise users re-authorize, which is typically seamless if still logged in.
auth.scopes_notes: Marketing APIs require rw_ads; other ads scopes include r_ads, r_ads_reporting, r_organization_admin, rw_organization_admin, w_member_social, r_member_boost, rw_member_boost. All scopes are member permissions (3-legged). Scopes are granted only after the matching product is approved.

access.production_restrictions: Access is tiered by ad-account count: Development allows read on accounts you administer, create 1 test ad account, and edit up to 5 ad accounts; Standard requires a support ticket and LinkedIn may decline upgrades at its discretion. All API calls at all tiers hit production data, so there is no sandbox. Ad accounts must be mapped to the app in the Developer Portal at Development tier, and the authenticating member needs an ad account role (e.g., ACCOUNT_MANAGER or CAMPAIGN_MANAGER) for rw_ads.

read_ops: List/read ad accounts and account user roles
Read campaign groups, campaigns and creatives
write_ops: Create ad accounts (Standard tier unlimited; Development 1 test account)
Update ad accounts/campaigns/creatives (edit limits by tier)
api.limitations: Covers ad accounts, campaign groups, campaigns, creatives, targeting, budget pricing and ad analytics. Write coverage is on campaign-management objects; reporting and targeting are read-only. Restricted products (Matched Audiences, Audience Insights, Media Planning) need extra approval. Company Intelligence is closed to new applications. Development tier caps edits to 5 ad accounts.

open_questions: Official LinkedIn MCP server: none found in searches; not exhaustively checked. Official status left unknown.
SDKs: no official LinkedIn Marketing API SDK was found; unknown.
Webhooks for general Advertising API events (campaign status, etc.) not established; only Lead Sync lead notifications seen in a snippet.
Rate limits for Advertising API not established from fetched pages (only ad-account count limits).
Paid plan requirement: no evidence found either way; unknown.

Deprecation: Marketing version 202601 sunsets Jan 15, 2027 per Microsoft Learn; 202508 sunset date from a search snippet (Aug 17, 2026) has passed as of 2026-11-23 and was not verified on a fetched page.

Repo identity conflict: a search result listed Nuraveda-Labs/linkedin-ads-mcp, but the fetched GitHub page is meshpilot-hq/linkedin-ads-mcp (README says maintained by Nuraveda Lab). Ownership should be checked.

Other community MCP servers (souravdasbiswas, stickerdaniel, Kembec, CData, Two Minute Reports, mcp-linkedin-ads npm) were seen in search results only and not verified; some are not Ads-focused or use browser sessions rather than the official API.
